jobs.description:
Mission

Energy markets are being reshaped in real time – and the technology behind trading sits right at the heart of it. As IT Domain Architect for Energy Trading, you will own the architectural vision for the systems that power Alpiq’s Trading Division, and turn today’s landscape into the target landscape of tomorrow.

You will define that target together with business and IT stakeholders, then steer our applications, integrations and data towards it – making sure every solution is fit for purpose, secure by design, scalable and genuinely aligned with how our trading and risk teams work. Spanning front, middle and back office across the full trade lifecycle, this is a role with real ownership, high visibility and the mandate to shape where we go next.

Your main responsibilities

•
• Define, own and continuously evolve the IT target landscape for the Trading Division – and drive the transformation that gets us there, hand in hand with business and IT.

• Keep a clear, living view of our trading landscape – trading, position and risk management, market data, pricing, settlement and regulatory reporting – and turn the gap to target into a pragmatic, prioritised roadmap.

• Shape solution designs across the trade lifecycle (front, middle and back office), balancing business needs, IT strategy, security, integration principles and operational reality.

• Be the go-to architecture partner for projects, product teams, vendors and system integrators, setting clear standards and guardrails for our ETRM, risk, market-data and settlement platforms.

• Safeguard quality where it matters most – reviewing architectural impact, risks, dependencies and technical design debt before major changes go live, with a sharp eye on data integrity, latency, resilience and auditability.

• Help steer architecture governance, design authority reviews, roadmap planning, portfolio priorities and make-or-buy decisions for the division.

Make sure trading regulation (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) is designed into the landscape from the start, rather than bolted on later.

• Champion standardisation, simplification, application reduction and modernisation – always weighing business value, security, sustainability, quality and cost.

Your impact

• This is where our value “Create value” comes to life. The decisions you make ensure the Trading Division’s technology investments deliver real, lasting business outcomes and support Alpiq’s long-term strategic direction.

Because you define the target landscape with the business and steer us towards it, you strike the right balance between innovation and risk, ambition and operational excellence. You will be a trusted sparring partner to trading, risk and IT – the person who translates bold ambitions and regulatory demands into architecture and technology decisions that make future growth and transformation possible.

Your profile

• We’re looking for an architect who is as comfortable with trading and risk as with technology. You likely bring:

• A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Financial Engineering or a related field – or equivalent hands-on experience.

• A track record in enterprise, domain or solution architecture, ideally within energy trading, commodities or financial markets.

• A solid grasp of the trade lifecycle and ETRM/CTRM systems (trading, position and risk management, market data, pricing, settlement and regulatory reporting) and platforms such as Murex, Endur or Orchestrade.

• Strong solution and integration architecture skills, plus data architecture and security know-how in real-time, data-intensive environments.

• The ability to turn business strategy, trading needs and regulation into a clear IT target landscape, solution designs and technology guardrails.

• Experience with architecture governance, design reviews, lifecycle and technical-debt management, and confident technology decision-making.

• Experience with Enterprise I ntegration P atterns (EIP) , Event Driven Architectures and with data centrics plat forms such as Foundry or Databri c ks

• Ease working across internal delivery teams and external service providers, system integrators and platform vendors.

• Excellent stakeholder-management, facilitation, communication and influencing skills, with a structured, analytical and business-minded approach.

Who You’ll Work With

You will sit at the crossroads of business and technology, working closely with:

• Trading, Portfolio Management and Risk teams across front, middle and back office

• Enterprise Architecture and the Design Authority

• Business Relationship Managers, Product Owners and Demand Managers

• Project Managers, Delivery Leads, Solution Architects and technical experts

• Security, Data, Integration, Infrastructure, Operations and Service Management

• ETRM platform vendors, system integrators and external partners

• Portfolio, Governance, Risk, Compliance and Finance stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

• A clear, shared IT target landscape for the Trading Division exists – and the estate is visibly moving towards it.

• Solutions are aligned with business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, security and regulatory requirements.

• Architecture decisions are transparent, well-documented , their context and lineage is tracked in Architecture Desciion Records and applied consistently across projects, products and suppliers.

• Risks, dependencies, exceptions, lifecycle impacts and technical debt are spotted and managed early.

• Roadmaps drive modernisation, simplification, application reduction and cost optimisation.

• Trading, risk and delivery teams receive clear, timely and practical guidance that accelerates quality delivery and business value.

Ready to help shape the future of energy trading at Alpiq? We’d love to meet you.

Perché definisci il paesaggio di destinazione con il business e ci spinga verso di esso, trovi il giusto equilibrio tra innovazione e rischio, ambizione ed eccellenza operativa. Sarai un partner di fiducia in commercio, rischio e IT. la persona che traduce ambizioni audaci e richieste normative in decisioni di architettura e tecnologia che rendono possibile la crescita e la trasformazione futura.

• Stiamo cercando un architetto che sia a suo agio con il commercio e il rischio come con la tecnologia.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Auftrag

Energiemärkte werden in Echtzeit neu gestaltet – und die Technologie hinter dem Handel steht im Mittelpunkt. Als IT-Domain-Architekt für Energiehandel werden Sie die architektonische Vision für die Systeme besitzen, die Alpiq, die Trading Division, befähigen und die Landschaft heute in die Ziellandschaft von morgen verwandeln.

Sie definieren dieses Ziel gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern aus Wirtschaft und IT, steuern unsere Anwendungen, Integrationen und Daten darauf zu – und stellen sicher, dass jede Lösung zweckgerecht, durch Design sicher, skalierbar und wirklich abgestimmt ist mit der Funktionsweise unserer Handels- und Risikoteams.Vorne, mittlere und hintere Büroräume über den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Handels hinweg sind eine Rolle mit echtem Eigentum, hoher Sichtbarkeit und dem Mandat, den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

•
• Definieren, besitzen und entwickeln Sie die IT-Ziellandschaft für die Trading Division kontinuierlich weiter – und treiben Sie die Transformation voran, die uns mit Business und IT verbindet.

• Halten Sie einen klaren und lebendigen Blick auf unsere Handelslandschaft – Handel, Position und Risikomanagement, Marktdaten, Preisgestaltung, Abrechnung und regulatorische Berichterstattung – und machen Sie die Lücke zum Ziel in eine pragmatische, priorisierte Roadmap.

• Design der Shape-Lösung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus des Handels (Vor-, Mittel- und Backoffice), die Balance zwischen Geschäftsbedürfnissen, IT-Strategie, Sicherheit, Integrationsprinzipien und betrieblicher Realität.

• Seien Sie der Go-to-Architektur-Partner für Projekte, Produktteams, Anbieter und Systemintegratoren und setzen Sie klare Standards und Leitplanken für unsere ETRM-, Risiko-, Marktdaten- und Abrechnungsplattformen.

• Schutz der Qualität, wo es am wichtigsten ist – Überprüfung der architektonischen Auswirkungen, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und technischen Design-Schulden, bevor große Änderungen gehen live, mit einem scharfen Auge auf Datenintegrität, Latenz, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Auditierbarkeit.

• Hilfe bei der Steuerung der Architektur-Governance, Design Authority Reviews, Roadmap-Planung, Portfolio-Prioritäten und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen für die Division.

Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Handelsregelung (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) von Anfang an in die Landschaft hinein entwickelt wird, anstatt später zu verschrauben.

• Champion Standardisierung, Vereinfachung, Anwendungsreduzierung und Modernisierung – immer mit der Abwägung von Unternehmenswert, Sicherheit, Nachhaltigkeit, Qualität und Kosten.

Ihre Wirkung

• Hier entsteht unser Wert, Werte schaffen, zum Leben. Die Entscheidungen, die Sie treffen, stellen sicher, dass die Trading Division, die Technologieinvestitionen echte, dauerhafte Geschäftsergebnisse liefern und Alpiq, die langfristige strategische Richtung unterstützen.

Da Sie die Ziellandschaft mit dem Unternehmen definieren und uns darauf hinsteuern, finden Sie das richtige Gleichgewicht zwischen Innovation und Risiko, Ehrgeiz und operativer Exzellenz. Sie werden ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Handel, Risiko und IT – der Person, die mutige Ambitionen und regulatorische Anforderungen in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen übersetzt, die zukünftiges Wachstum und Transformation ermöglichen.

Ihr Profil

• Wir suchen einen Architekten, der sich mit dem Handel und dem Risiko genauso wohlfühlt wie mit der Technologie.

Vous définirez cette cible en collaboration avec les acteurs commerciaux et informatiques, puis orienterez nos applications, intégrations et données vers elle – en veillant à ce que chaque solution soit adaptée à l'objectif, sécurisée par la conception, évolutive et réellement alignée sur la façon dont nos équipes de trading et de risque fonctionnent.

• Conception de solutions de forme tout au long du cycle de vie du commerce (avant, milieu et arrière-bureau), équilibre des besoins des entreprises, stratégie informatique, sécurité, principes d'intégration et réalité opérationnelle.

• Aider à orienter la gouvernance de l'architecture, les examens des pouvoirs de conception, la planification de la feuille de route, les priorités du portefeuille et les décisions de prise ou d'achat pour la division.

• C'est là que notre valeur,Créer de la valeur, prend vie. Les décisions que vous prenez garantissent la division Trading, les investissements technologiques fournissent des résultats opérationnels réels et durables et soutiennent Alpiq, l'orientation stratégique à long terme.

Parce que vous définissez le paysage cible avec l'entreprise et nous dirigez vers elle, vous trouvez le juste équilibre entre innovation et risque, ambition et excellence opérationnelle. Vous serez un partenaire fiable pour le commerce, le risque et l'informatique – la personne qui traduit des ambitions audacieuses et des exigences réglementaires en décisions d'architecture et de technologie qui rendent possible la croissance et la transformation futures.

• Nous, sommes à la recherche d'un architecte qui est aussi à l'aise avec le trading et le risque que avec la technologie.

Tradings

Head of Algorithmic Trading Governance

•

Olten, CH | Lausanne, CH - 100% | Full time

About the Role

Alpiq believes that algorithmic trading and automation will play an increasingly important role in the future of energy trading. While traders remain fully accountable for commercial decisions, risk-taking, and portfolio performance, algorithms are expected to become a core capability supporting execution, optimization, analysis, and decision-making across the trading value chain.

The Head of Algorithmic Trading Governance is responsible for establishing, governing, and scaling Alpiq's algorithmic trading framework across Asset Trading, Merchant Trading, and Structured Energy Management activities.

The role does not manage a proprietary trading book. Instead, it acts as the business owner and governance lead for algorithmic trading initiatives, ensuring consistency, transparency, performance measurement, risk oversight, and adoption across all trading activities.

Initially focused on intraday and day-ahead algorithmic initiatives supporting Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Renewable Energy Sources (RES), the mandate will progressively expand to additional portfolios, including hydro assets and future algorithmic trading applications across Alpiq's European trading activities.

The position sits within the Quantitative Analytics team and operates at the intersection of Trading, IT, Risk Management, Compliance, and Data & Analytics.

Your main accountabilities

1.Algorithmic Trading Governance

• Establish and maintain Alpiq's governance framework for algorithmic trading across all trading value chains.

• Develop standards, controls, validation processes, approval mechanisms, and documentation requirements for algorithm deployment.

• Ensure clear accountability principles whereby traders remain responsible for trading decisions and portfolio outcomes while leveraging algorithmic tools.

• Work closely with Risk and Compliance to develop robust controls around algorithm usage and automated execution activities.

• Define model governance and review processes covering algorithm development, testing, approval, monitoring, modification, and retirement.

2. Portfolio-Wide Algo Coordination & Standardization

• Create a consolidated overview of all existing algorithmic initiatives across Trading.

• Assess and document desk-level developments currently operating within Intraday, Day-Ahead, BESS, RES, and other Gas Merchant trading activities for Long term.

• Identify duplication, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Drive harmonization of algorithmic approaches across portfolios while preserving local optimization needs.

• Support the extension of successful approaches to additional portfolios, including Hydro and future flexibility assets.

3. Algo Performance Management

• Develop a framework of KPIs and performance metrics for algorithm assessment.

• Monitor algorithm effectiveness under different market environments and liquidity conditions.

• Conduct regular performance reviews and recommend improvements, recalibration, suspension, or retirement of underperforming algorithms.

• Capture and document lessons learned to support future strategy development and knowledge sharing.

• Establish transparency on value creation and operational performance of algorithmic initiatives.

4. Trading Community Enablement

• Lead the adoption of algorithmic trading capabilities across the Trading organization.

• Develop training programs, best practices, user documentation, and onboarding materials.

• Promote a culture where traders understand, monitor, challenge, and effectively utilize algorithmic trading solutions.

• Build an algorithm-enabled trading organization where algorithmic tools become part of every trader’s standard toolkit. The ambition is that within two years, all Alpiq traders are proficient in the use, supervision, and interpretation of algorithmic trading solutions, while retaining full accountability for trading decisions, risk-taking, and portfolio performance.

• Establish a community of practice that fosters knowledge sharing between traders, quants, analysts, developers, Risk, and IT.

• Drive change management and user engagement to accelerate the adoption of automation across Trading's value chains.

5. Strategic Development of Trading Automation

• Define the long-term roadmap for algorithmic trading and automation across Alpiq.

• Evaluate opportunities to expand the use of algorithms beyond execution into analytics, opportunity identification, decision support, forecasting, and idea generation.

• Assess internal versus external development opportunities and support the integration of third-party solutions where appropriate.

• Maintain oversight of external providers and strategic partnerships supporting algorithmic capabilities.

6. Product Ownership and Business Sponsorship

• Act as “Business Sponsor” for strategic algorithmic trading initiatives and transformation projects (4PP).

• Partner closely with Business Technology Transformation and IT including Data teams to ensure developments align and build on Alpiq's broader data transformation roadmap.

• Define business priorities and oversee implementation roadmaps for algorithmic trading platforms and supporting infrastructure.

• Ensure investment decisions and budgets are aligned with business value creation and strategic objectives.

• Support the launch and governance of Alpiq's dedicated algorithmic trading program starting in 2027.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Maintain strong engagement with trading teams in Lausanne and Olten. Algo team shall sit among Traders.

• Work closely with Quantitative Analytics, Risk Management, Compliance, IT, Data Engineering, and Trading leadership.

• Facilitate alignment between business needs, technical capabilities, and governance requirements.

• Promote consistency of algorithmic trading practices across all functions and locations.

Send us your application

Are you looking to make an impact in the energy sector? Become part of Alpiq - your energy matters!

Apply now

Your profile

Experience & Market Knowledge

• Deep understanding of European power markets, including Day-Ahead, Intraday, Balancing, and flexibility markets.

• Strong knowledge of trading processes across physical and financial energy portfolios.

• Experience with algorithmic trading, trading automation, optimization, or quantitative energy trading environments.

• Understanding of flexible asset classes such as batteries, hydro, renewable generation, and flexibility portfolios.

• Proven leadership experience with the ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate innovation into scalable business practices.

• Curious, forward-looking, and technology-oriented mindset, with a genuine interest in the future evolution of energy trading and automation.

• Ability to operate effectively in a rapidly evolving environment, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic execution as markets, technologies, and organizational priorities evolve.

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate across Trading, Quantitative Analytics, IT, Risk, Compliance, and senior management.

• Strong change management capabilities, with experience driving adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working across an organization.

Quantitative & Technical Expertise

• Strong understanding of algorithm design, quantitative modeling, machine learning applications, and automated execution frameworks.

• Familiarity with Python and modern data analytics environments.

• Ability to challenge and oversee technical developments without necessarily performing day-to-day coding activities.

• Understanding of data architecture, trading systems, and algorithm performance measurement frameworks.

Governance, Risk & Leadership

• Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls, and operational processes.

• Strong understanding of risk management principles and regulatory requirements relevant to automated trading.

• Ability to operate across multiple departments and influence stakeholders without direct hierarchical authority.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Structured and strategic thinker capable of translating innovation into scalable business practices.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will:

• Establish a robust algorithmic trading governance framework across Alpiq.

• Create full visibility and oversight of all algorithmic trading initiatives.

• Increase algorithm adoption across trading teams.

• Drive standardization and consistency across portfolios and value chains.

• Improve transparency on algorithm performance and value creation.

• Ensure algorithms are deployed safely, efficiently, and in line with risk and compliance standards.

• Position Alpiq to scale algorithmic trading capabilities as a strategic competitive advantage while maintaining clear human accountability for trading decisions.

jobs.title: DA/ID Power Trader (UK focus)
jobs.description:
Mission

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing trading strategies across European short-term power markets, with a particular focus on the UK market. While acting as a specialist for Great Britain (GB) power trading, you will actively participate in the trading and optimization of Alpiq's wider European portfolio covering Germany, France, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands and the Nordic power markets. The role combines UK market specialization with broader participation in Alpiq's CWE and Nordic trading activities.

You will be joining a team of experienced traders and algo traders operating across Europe on a 7/7-day shift basis during extended working hours. The team is responsible for proprietary trading activities as well as the optimization of renewable assets and batteries from DA down to balancing markets. Working closely with analysts, quantitative researchers, meteorologists, IT developers and our 24/7 intraday desk, you will contribute to maximizing value creation in increasingly automated and data-driven power markets.

Your main responsibilities

• Trade a virtual power plant portfolio of wind/solar in DE, FR, FI, SE on a 7/7-day shift basis in Intraday and Day Ahead market

• Act as the in-house expert for UK short-term power markets, bringing deep knowledge of Day-Ahead, Intraday, balancing and flexibility market dynamics.

• Develop and execute proprietary trading strategies across UK, CWE and Nordic power markets, with a particular focus on UK market opportunities arising from renewable penetration, system imbalances, storage assets and transmission constraints.

• Contribute to the commercial development and optimization of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in the UK market by identifying monetization opportunities, trading strategies and route-to-market solutions across wholesale, balancing and ancillary service markets.

• Provide market expertise on battery economics, congestion management opportunities, revenue stacking and short-term optimization strategies.

• Manage the risk exposure of proprietary trading positions in accordance with internal mandates, risk policies and trading limits.

• Monitor and analyse market fundamentals including weather developments, generation forecasts, renewable production, demand forecasts, fuel prices, interconnector flows and balancing market signals.

• Contribute to the development, testing and implementation of algorithmic trading strategies together with Alpiq's algo trading and quantitative teams.

• Participate in the conceptualization and continuous improvement of automated trading services, forecasting models, workflow automation and analytical tools.

• Perform daily assessment of trading performance through P&L analysis, strategy reviews and back-testing of trading decisions.

• Prepare regular trading performance reports and communicate market developments, opportunities and strategic recommendations to stakeholders.

• Share market knowledge, best practices and trading insights with colleagues across the trading organization and support onboarding of new team members.

• Collaborate closely with originators, pricing and quantitative analysts, developers, risk managers, operations and middle-office teams to improve overall trading performance.

• Help further develop Alpiq's position as a leading player in short-term power trading across the UK, Central Western Europe and Nordic power markets.
Your impact

While serving as the UK's market expert within the desk, you will contribute to the overall performance of the CWE & Nordics short-term trading team. Your ability to connect developments in the UK market with dynamics across Continental Europe and the Nordics will help capture cross-market opportunities and strengthen Alpiq's pan-European trading capabilities.

Your profile

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in engineering, Economics, IT or similar

• Minimum 2 years of experience in power trading with proven expertise in UK Day-Ahead and Intraday power markets.

• Demonstrated experience in Renewables trading and in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), flexibility markets or battery optimization strategies within the UK market.

• Understanding of European Short Term Power markets.

• Knowledge of French, Belgian and Dutch power markets is a strong advantage, given their close interaction with UK interconnector flows.

• Strong analytical skills with a strategic mindset

• Open-minded, multi-tasking and used to working in a fast paced, high-pressure environment

• Strong Team-player and problem-solver

• Excellent commercial mind-set and very good communicator

• Good programming and IT skills (ideally Python).

• Experience with algorithmic and systematic trading using automated trading environments is considered a strong advantage.

• Strong interest in leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics to enhance trading performance.

• Proficient level of English.
